spec.title: Stratum
spec.description: NTP stratum level. 1 = locked to GPS PPS reference (best). ≥2 means relying on network peers instead of GPS.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony" and r._field == "system_time" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: int(v: r.stratum), _time: r._time}))

spec.title: Source Offsets (by peer)
spec.description: Offset of each configured source (NMEA, PPS, upstream pool servers) relative to chrony's best time estimate.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony_sources" and r._field == "latest_measurement" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "peer"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

spec.title: Source Reachability (255 = fully reachable)
spec.description: 8-poll reachability register per source. 255 = every recent poll succeeded; lower = intermittent connectivity.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony_sources" and r._field == "reachability" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "peer"])
  |> yield(name: "last")

spec.title: Source Offset History (by peer)
spec.description: Regression-based offset estimate per source from chrony's statistics engine (distinct from the live measurement above).

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony_sourcestats" and r._field == "offset" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "peer"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

spec.title: Source Residual Frequency (by peer)
spec.description: Residual frequency error per source after regression correction — how well each source's clock rate is characterized.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony_sourcestats" and r._field == "residual_frequency" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "peer"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

spec.title: Source Std Dev (by peer)
spec.description: Standard deviation of offset samples per source — how noisy/consistent each source's measurements are.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony_sourcestats" and r._field == "stddev" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "peer"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

spec.title: Source Sample Count (by peer)
spec.description: Number of samples in chrony's regression filter per source. More samples generally means a steadier frequency estimate.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony_sourcestats" and r._field == "samples" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "peer"])
  |> yield(name: "last")

spec.title: CPU Temperature (°C)
spec.description:
Raw cpu_temp values are millidegrees; this panel divides by 1000.
Alert thresholds: warning ≥70°C, critical ≥80°C (see Alerting in monitoring/README.md)

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_temp" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

spec.title: System Time Offset
spec.description: Current offset between system clock and true time per chrony. Should stay in the ns–low µs range when GPS-locked.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony" and r._field == "system_time" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: RMS Offset
spec.description: Long-term RMS average of clock offset — a steadier indicator of sync quality than the instantaneous System Time Offset.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony" and r._field == "rms_offset" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Clock Frequency Error
spec.description: Rate of drift in the Pi's local clock relative to true time, before chrony's correction. Typically a few ppm on Pi 5 hardware.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony" and r._field == "frequency" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Frequency Skew
spec.description: Estimated uncertainty in the Clock Frequency Error measurement. Lower = more confident frequency correction.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony" and r._field == "skew" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Root Dispersion
spec.description: Accumulated uncertainty in time traced back through the reference chain to GPS/PPS. Should stay in the µs range.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony" and r._field == "root_dispersion" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: System / Last / RMS Offset
spec.description: Combined view of current, most-recent, and long-term RMS offset — useful for spotting trends or instability.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "system_time" or r._field == "last_offset" or r._field == "rms_offset")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

spec.title: Frequency / Residual Freq / Skew
spec.description: Combined view of frequency error, residual frequency, and skew — useful for diagnosing oscillator drift.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frequency" or r._field == "residual_freq" or r._field == "skew")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")
